title: General Incident Response
description: A structured approach to handling security incidents effectively

steps.title: Identify & Confirm
steps.content: Verify the incident is real. Gather initial information about what happened, when, and what systems are affected.
steps.tip: Use a dedicated incident tracking system to log all actions.

steps.title: Contain the Threat
steps.content: Isolate affected systems from the network to prevent spread. Disconnect from the internet but keep systems powered on.
steps.warning: Do NOT turn off systems - this may destroy volatile memory evidence.

steps.title: Notify Stakeholders
steps.content: Alert the incident response team, management, and legal/compliance as needed.

steps.title: Investigate & Analyze
steps.content: Collect logs, memory dumps, and forensic images. Determine the attack vector and scope.

steps.title: Eradicate & Recover
steps.content: Remove malware, close vulnerabilities, reset credentials. Restore from clean backups.

steps.title: Post-Incident Review
steps.content: Document lessons learned and update security controls within 72 hours.

title: Phishing Attack Response
description: Steps to take if you clicked a phishing link or provided information

steps.title: Disconnect Immediately
steps.content: Close the phishing page and disconnect from the network to prevent malware communication.

steps.title: Document What Happened
steps.content: Write down exactly what you clicked, entered, or downloaded while it's fresh in memory.

steps.title: Change Compromised Credentials
steps.content: Change passwords immediately, starting with the compromised account.
steps.warning: Use a different, clean device to change passwords.

steps.title: Enable 2FA
steps.content: Add two-factor authentication to all important accounts.

steps.title: Scan for Malware
steps.content: Run a full antivirus scan. Consider using multiple scanners.

steps.title: Monitor Accounts
steps.content: Check bank statements and account activity for unauthorized access.

steps.title: Report the Phishing
steps.content: Report to IT, forward to reportphishing@apwg.org, and notify the impersonated company.

title: Ransomware Attack Response
description: Critical steps when your systems are encrypted by ransomware

steps.title: Isolate Infected Systems
steps.content: Disconnect affected computers from the network immediately.
steps.warning: Do not turn off the computer - it may destroy decryption keys.

steps.title: Identify the Ransomware
steps.content: Take photos of the ransom note. Check nomoreransom.org for free decryptors.

steps.title: Report to Authorities
steps.content: File a report with FBI IC3, local law enforcement, and CISA.

steps.title: Do NOT Pay
steps.content: Paying doesn't guarantee recovery and funds criminal operations.
steps.warning: Only 8% of payers get all data back. Many are attacked again.

steps.title: Preserve Evidence
steps.content: Create forensic images before recovery attempts.

steps.title: Check for Decryptors
steps.content: Visit nomoreransom.org for your ransomware variant.

steps.title: Restore from Backups
steps.content: Wipe infected systems and restore from clean, offline backups.

steps.title: Strengthen Defenses
steps.content: Implement 3-2-1 backup strategy, patch systems, deploy EDR.

title: Personal Data Breach Response
description: What to do when your personal information is exposed

steps.title: Confirm the Breach
steps.content: Verify through official communications. Check haveibeenpwned.com.

steps.title: Identify Exposed Data
steps.content: Determine what was compromised: passwords, financial info, SSN, etc.

steps.title: Change Passwords
steps.content: Change the breached account password and any accounts using the same password.

steps.title: Enable 2FA
steps.content: Add two-factor authentication to all important accounts.

steps.title: Monitor Financial Accounts
steps.content: Check statements for unauthorized transactions. Set up alerts.

steps.title: Credit Freeze
steps.content: Place a free freeze with Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion if SSN was exposed.

steps.title: Check Credit Reports
steps.content: Get free reports from annualcreditreport.com.

steps.title: Watch for Phishing
steps.content: Be extra skeptical of communications referencing your personal info.

steps.title: Document Everything
steps.content: Keep records for identity theft claims or lawsuits.

title: Account Compromised Recovery
description: How to recover and secure a hacked account

steps.title: Regain Access
steps.content: Use "Forgot Password" or contact platform support with identity verification.

steps.title: Change Password
steps.content: Create a new, strong, unique password (16+ characters).

steps.title: Enable 2FA
steps.content: Set up two-factor authentication using an authenticator app.

steps.title: Review Activity
steps.content: Check login history, sent messages, purchases, and connected apps.

steps.title: Revoke Sessions
steps.content: Sign out of all other sessions/devices.

steps.title: Remove Unauthorized Changes
steps.content: Check for changed recovery options, forwarding rules, or profile changes.
steps.warning: Hackers often add their own recovery options.

steps.title: Check Connected Accounts
steps.content: Secure any accounts using OAuth/SSO with the compromised account.

steps.title: Alert Contacts
steps.content: Inform contacts about the compromise - they may have received malicious messages.

title: Malware Infection Cleanup
description: Steps to clean and recover from a malware infection

steps.title: Disconnect from Network
steps.content: Unplug ethernet and disable WiFi.

steps.title: Enter Safe Mode
steps.content: Restart in Safe Mode to limit malware activity.
steps.tip: Windows: Hold Shift while clicking Restart.

steps.title: Run Antivirus Scan
steps.content: Run full scans with multiple tools: your AV, Malwarebytes, HitmanPro.

steps.title: Remove Suspicious Programs
steps.content: Check installed programs for unfamiliar items.

steps.title: Clear Browser Data
steps.content: Remove suspicious extensions, clear cookies and cache.

steps.title: Update Everything
steps.content: Update OS, browsers, and all software.

steps.title: Change All Passwords
steps.content: Assume all passwords were stolen. Change from a clean device.

title: DDoS Attack Response
description: How to respond to a distributed denial of service attack

steps.title: Confirm the Attack
steps.content: Distinguish between DDoS and legitimate traffic spikes or infrastructure issues.

steps.title: Activate DDoS Protection
steps.content: Enable CDN/DDoS protection services like Cloudflare, AWS Shield, or Akamai.

steps.title: Contact ISP
steps.content: Notify your ISP - they may be able to filter traffic upstream.

steps.title: Implement Rate Limiting
steps.content: Configure aggressive rate limiting on firewalls and load balancers.

steps.title: Block Attack Sources
steps.content: Identify and block attacking IP ranges if pattern is identifiable.

steps.title: Scale Resources
steps.content: If using cloud, scale up to absorb attack traffic.

steps.title: Document the Attack
steps.content: Log attack patterns, duration, and impact for analysis.

steps.title: Post-Attack Analysis
steps.content: Review what worked, update DDoS response plan.

title: Insider Threat Response
description: Handling suspected malicious insider activity

steps.title: Preserve Evidence Quietly
steps.content: Begin logging and monitoring without alerting the suspect.

steps.title: Involve HR and Legal
steps.content: Consult HR and legal before taking action.
steps.warning: Improper handling can lead to legal liability.

steps.title: Review Access Logs
steps.content: Analyze file access, email, and system logs for anomalies.

steps.title: Assess Data Exposure
steps.content: Determine what data the insider accessed or exfiltrated.

steps.title: Restrict Access
steps.content: Limit access to sensitive systems while investigating.

steps.title: Conduct Interview
steps.content: Work with HR to conduct appropriate interviews.

steps.title: Revoke Access
steps.content: When appropriate, revoke all access and collect company devices.

steps.title: Review Policies
steps.content: Update access controls and monitoring based on lessons learned.

title: Supply Chain Attack Response
description: Responding to compromised vendor or software supply chain

steps.title: Identify Affected Systems
steps.content: Determine which systems use the compromised software/vendor.

steps.title: Isolate Affected Systems
steps.content: Quarantine systems running compromised software.

steps.title: Block C2 Communications
steps.content: Add known IOCs to firewall blocklists.

steps.title: Assess Impact
steps.content: Determine if attackers gained access through the supply chain.

steps.title: Contact Vendor
steps.content: Coordinate with the affected vendor for remediation guidance.

steps.title: Roll Back or Patch
steps.content: Revert to known-good versions or apply vendor patches.

steps.title: Hunt for Persistence
steps.content: Look for backdoors or persistence mechanisms left by attackers.

steps.title: Review Vendor Security
steps.content: Assess vendor security practices and contract terms.

title: Cryptojacking Response
description: Detecting and removing unauthorized cryptocurrency mining

steps.title: Identify Symptoms
steps.content: Look for high CPU usage, slow performance, overheating.

steps.title: Check Running Processes
steps.content: Look for unknown processes consuming high CPU.

steps.title: Check Browser Extensions
steps.content: Review and remove suspicious browser extensions.

steps.title: Scan for Malware
steps.content: Run anti-malware scans to detect mining software.

steps.title: Check Cron Jobs/Tasks
steps.content: Review scheduled tasks for mining scripts.

steps.title: Block Mining Pools
steps.content: Add known mining pool domains to blocklists.

steps.title: Update and Patch
steps.content: Update all software to close exploitation vectors.

title: Password Security Setup
description: Establishing strong password hygiene from scratch

steps.title: Get a Password Manager
steps.content: Choose Bitwarden (free), 1Password, or Dashlane.

steps.title: Create Strong Master Password
steps.content: Use 16+ characters. Consider a passphrase.
steps.warning: This is the ONE password you must memorize.

steps.title: Import Existing Passwords
steps.content: Export from browser and import to password manager.

steps.title: Audit Your Passwords
steps.content: Use the security audit feature to find weak/reused passwords.

steps.title: Replace Weak Passwords
steps.content: Generate new unique 16+ character passwords for each account.

steps.title: Enable 2FA Everywhere
steps.content: Add two-factor authentication to all accounts that support it.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication Setup
description: Implementing strong MFA across your accounts

steps.title: Choose Your Methods
steps.content: Prefer authenticator apps > SMS > email. Hardware keys are best.

steps.title: Get an Authenticator App
steps.content: Install Authy, Google Authenticator, or Microsoft Authenticator.

steps.title: Prioritize Critical Accounts
steps.content: Start with email, banking, and primary cloud accounts.

steps.title: Enable MFA
steps.content: Go to security settings of each account and enable 2FA.

steps.title: Save Backup Codes
steps.content: Store recovery codes securely in password manager or safe.
steps.warning: Without backup codes, you may lose account access.

steps.title: Consider Hardware Keys
steps.content: For high-security accounts, use YubiKey or similar.

steps.title: Test Recovery
steps.content: Verify you can recover access using backup methods.

title: Password Manager Implementation
description: Complete guide to setting up a password manager

steps.title: Choose a Manager
steps.content: Bitwarden (free/open), 1Password (family), LastPass, Dashlane.

steps.title: Create Account
steps.content: Sign up with your email and create a strong master password.

steps.title: Install Everywhere
steps.content: Install browser extensions and mobile apps.

steps.title: Export Browser Passwords
steps.content: Export saved passwords from Chrome/Firefox/Safari.

steps.title: Import to Manager
steps.content: Import the exported CSV into your password manager.

steps.title: Delete Browser Passwords
steps.content: Clear saved passwords from browsers and disable saving.

steps.title: Learn the Workflow
steps.content: Practice using the manager to fill and generate passwords.

steps.title: Set Up Emergency Access
steps.content: Configure trusted contacts for emergency access.

title: Hardware Security Key Setup
description: Configuring YubiKey or similar hardware authentication

steps.title: Choose Your Keys
steps.content: Get at least 2 keys (YubiKey, Google Titan, SoloKeys).
steps.tip: Always have a backup key in case you lose one.

steps.title: Register Primary Key
steps.content: Add the key to your most important accounts (Google, Microsoft, etc.).

steps.title: Register Backup Key
steps.content: Add your second key to the same accounts.

steps.title: Store Backup Safely
steps.content: Keep backup key in a secure location (safe, bank box).

steps.title: Enable on Password Manager
steps.content: Add hardware key as 2FA for your password manager.

steps.title: Test Both Keys
steps.content: Verify both keys work on all registered accounts.

steps.title: Document Registrations
steps.content: Keep a list of which accounts have which keys registered.

title: Passkey Implementation
description: Setting up passwordless authentication with passkeys

steps.title: Understand Passkeys
steps.content: Passkeys use biometrics/device PIN instead of passwords.

steps.title: Check Device Support
steps.content: Ensure your devices support passkeys (iOS 16+, Android 9+, recent browsers).

steps.title: Start with Major Accounts
steps.content: Google, Microsoft, Apple, and GitHub support passkeys.

steps.title: Create Passkey
steps.content: Go to account security settings and add a passkey.

steps.title: Set Up on Multiple Devices
steps.content: Create passkeys on phone, computer, and tablet.

steps.title: Keep Password as Backup
steps.content: Maintain a strong password until passkeys are widespread.

steps.title: Sync Across Devices
steps.content: Use iCloud Keychain, Google Password Manager, or 1Password for sync.

title: Single Sign-On Security
description: Securing your SSO/OAuth connected accounts

steps.title: Identify SSO Accounts
steps.content: List all accounts where you "Sign in with Google/Apple/Facebook".

steps.title: Secure the Primary
steps.content: Your SSO provider account is critical - use strong password + 2FA.

steps.title: Review Connected Apps
steps.content: Check Google/Facebook/Apple settings for connected applications.

steps.title: Revoke Unused Access
steps.content: Remove apps you no longer use or don't recognize.

steps.title: Check Permissions
steps.content: Review what data each connected app can access.

steps.title: Consider Separation
steps.content: For critical accounts, use separate passwords instead of SSO.

steps.title: Monitor Activity
steps.content: Regularly review SSO provider security activity logs.

title: Home Network Security
description: Securing your home network against threats

steps.title: Access Router Settings
steps.content: Connect to router admin panel (usually 192.168.1.1).

steps.title: Change Default Credentials
steps.content: Change router admin password from default.
steps.warning: Admin password is different from WiFi password.

steps.title: Update Firmware
steps.content: Check for and install firmware updates.

steps.title: Use Strong Encryption
steps.content: Enable WPA3 or WPA2-AES. Never use WEP.

steps.title: Change Network Name
steps.content: Use SSID that doesn't identify you or router brand.

steps.title: Disable WPS
steps.content: WiFi Protected Setup has known vulnerabilities.

steps.title: Create Guest Network
steps.content: Isolate visitors and IoT devices.
steps.tip: Put smart devices on guest network.

steps.title: Enable Firewall
steps.content: Enable router firewall, disable remote management.

steps.title: Use DNS Filtering
steps.content: Change DNS to Cloudflare (1.1.1.1) or Quad9 (9.9.9.9).

steps.title: Monitor Devices
steps.content: Regularly review connected devices.

title: VPN Configuration
description: Setting up and using a VPN for privacy and security

steps.title: Choose a Provider
steps.content: Select reputable VPN: Mullvad, ProtonVPN, NordVPN, ExpressVPN.

steps.title: Check Privacy Policy
steps.content: Verify no-logs policy and jurisdiction.

steps.title: Install Applications
steps.content: Install VPN app on all devices.

steps.title: Configure Kill Switch
steps.content: Enable kill switch to block traffic if VPN drops.

steps.title: Select Protocols
steps.content: Use WireGuard or OpenVPN for best security.

steps.title: Test for Leaks
steps.content: Check for DNS and IP leaks at ipleak.net.

steps.title: Set Auto-Connect
steps.content: Configure to auto-connect on untrusted networks.

steps.title: Choose Server Wisely
steps.content: Use nearby servers for speed, distant for privacy.

title: Public WiFi Safety
description: Staying secure on public wireless networks

steps.title: Use VPN Always
steps.content: Connect to VPN before using any public WiFi.

steps.title: Verify Network Name
steps.content: Confirm the correct network name with staff.
steps.warning: Evil twin attacks use similar names.

steps.title: Disable Auto-Connect
steps.content: Turn off automatic connection to open networks.

steps.title: Use HTTPS Only
steps.content: Only visit HTTPS sites. Install HTTPS Everywhere.

steps.title: Avoid Sensitive Activities
steps.content: Don't access banking or enter passwords.

steps.title: Turn Off Sharing
steps.content: Disable file sharing and AirDrop.

steps.title: Forget Network After
steps.content: Remove the network from saved networks when done.

steps.title: Use Mobile Data Instead
steps.content: When possible, use phone hotspot instead.

title: Firewall Configuration
description: Setting up personal and network firewalls

steps.title: Enable OS Firewall
steps.content: Ensure Windows Firewall or macOS Firewall is on.

steps.title: Review Inbound Rules
steps.content: Check which apps are allowed incoming connections.

steps.title: Block by Default
steps.content: Set policy to deny incoming, allow outgoing.

steps.title: Create App Rules
steps.content: Only allow necessary applications through firewall.

steps.title: Enable Logging
steps.content: Turn on firewall logging to detect suspicious activity.

steps.title: Configure Router Firewall
steps.content: Enable firewall on your router as first line of defense.

steps.title: Consider Third-Party
steps.content: For advanced control, consider GlassWire or Little Snitch.

title: DNS Security Setup
description: Configuring secure and private DNS

steps.title: Choose DNS Provider
steps.content: Cloudflare (1.1.1.1), Quad9 (9.9.9.9), or NextDNS.

steps.title: Configure on Router
steps.content: Change DNS in router settings to protect all devices.

steps.title: Configure on Devices
steps.content: Set DNS on individual devices as backup.

steps.title: Enable DoH/DoT
steps.content: Use DNS over HTTPS or DNS over TLS for encryption.

steps.title: Enable Malware Blocking
steps.content: Use DNS providers with malware filtering.

steps.title: Consider NextDNS
steps.content: For customizable filtering and logging.

steps.title: Test Configuration
steps.content: Verify DNS is working at dnsleaktest.com.

title: Network Segmentation
description: Separating network zones for better security

steps.title: Identify Device Categories
steps.content: Group devices: work, personal, IoT, guests.

steps.title: Create Separate Networks
steps.content: Use VLANs or separate SSIDs for each category.

steps.title: Isolate IoT Devices
steps.content: Put smart home devices on their own network.
steps.tip: IoT devices are often poorly secured.

steps.title: Create Guest Network
steps.content: Guests should not access your main network.

steps.title: Configure Firewall Rules
steps.content: Restrict traffic between network segments.

steps.title: Separate Work Devices
steps.content: Keep work devices on dedicated network if possible.

steps.title: Document Configuration
steps.content: Keep records of network layout and rules.

title: Router Security Hardening
description: Comprehensive router security configuration

steps.title: Update Firmware
steps.content: Install latest firmware and enable auto-updates.

steps.title: Change Admin Credentials
steps.content: Use strong, unique admin password.

steps.title: Disable Remote Management
steps.content: Turn off remote administration unless needed.

steps.title: Disable UPnP
steps.content: Universal Plug and Play can be exploited.
steps.warning: Some devices may require UPnP to function.

steps.title: Enable WPA3
steps.content: Use strongest available encryption.

steps.title: Disable WPS
steps.content: WiFi Protected Setup is vulnerable to attacks.

steps.title: Change Default SSID
steps.content: Don't reveal router brand in network name.

steps.title: Enable MAC Filtering
steps.content: Optional: whitelist known devices.

steps.title: Review Port Forwarding
steps.content: Remove unnecessary port forwarding rules.

steps.title: Enable Logging
steps.content: Turn on access logs for security monitoring.

title: Mobile Device Security
description: Securing your smartphone or tablet

steps.title: Set Strong Lock
steps.content: Use 6+ digit PIN, pattern, or biometric lock.

steps.title: Enable Encryption
steps.content: Ensure device encryption is enabled (default on modern devices).

steps.title: Enable Find My Device
steps.content: Set up Find My iPhone or Find My Device for Android.

steps.title: Update Regularly
steps.content: Install OS and app updates promptly.

steps.title: Review App Permissions
steps.content: Audit and restrict app permissions.

steps.title: Install from Official Stores
steps.content: Only use App Store or Google Play.

steps.title: Enable Remote Wipe
steps.content: Ensure you can remotely wipe if lost.

steps.title: Use Secure Messaging
steps.content: Use Signal or WhatsApp for encrypted messaging.

title: App Permission Audit
description: Reviewing and restricting mobile app permissions

steps.title: Access Permission Settings
steps.content: iOS: Settings > Privacy. Android: Settings > Apps > Permissions.

steps.title: Review Location Access
steps.content: Limit to "While Using" or "Never" for most apps.

steps.title: Review Camera/Microphone
steps.content: Only allow for apps that genuinely need it.

steps.title: Check Contacts Access
steps.content: Many apps request contacts unnecessarily.

steps.title: Review Photos Access
steps.content: Consider "Selected Photos" instead of "All Photos".

steps.title: Disable Background Refresh
steps.content: Turn off for apps that don't need it.

steps.title: Review Tracking
steps.content: iOS: Disable "Allow Apps to Request to Track".

steps.title: Repeat Regularly
steps.content: Audit permissions monthly or after installing new apps.

title: Lost/Stolen Phone Response
description: What to do when your phone is lost or stolen

steps.title: Try to Locate
steps.content: Use Find My iPhone or Find My Device to locate.

steps.title: Mark as Lost
steps.content: Enable Lost Mode to lock and display contact info.

steps.title: Remote Wipe if Needed
steps.content: If recovery unlikely and contains sensitive data, remote wipe.
steps.warning: Wiping is irreversible - try location first.

steps.title: Change Passwords
steps.content: Change passwords for accounts accessed on the phone.

steps.title: Deauthorize Device
steps.content: Remove the device from account trusted devices.

steps.title: Contact Carrier
steps.content: Report to carrier to suspend SIM and prevent charges.

steps.title: File Police Report
steps.content: Report theft to police with device details.

steps.title: Monitor Accounts
steps.content: Watch for unauthorized access to your accounts.

title: BYOD Security
description: Securing personal devices used for work

steps.title: Understand Policies
steps.content: Know your organization's BYOD policy and requirements.

steps.title: Enable Device Encryption
steps.content: Ensure full device encryption is enabled.

steps.title: Use Work Profile
steps.content: Separate work and personal data using work profiles.

steps.title: Install MDM if Required
steps.content: Install required mobile device management software.

steps.title: Use Strong Authentication
steps.content: Enable biometric + PIN for device access.

steps.title: Keep Updated
steps.content: Maintain current OS and security patches.

steps.title: Use Approved Apps
steps.content: Only use approved apps for work tasks.

steps.title: Secure Connections
steps.content: Use VPN when accessing work resources.

title: Mobile Malware Removal
description: Cleaning malware from mobile devices

steps.title: Identify Symptoms
steps.content: Look for battery drain, data usage spikes, popups, unknown apps.

steps.title: Boot in Safe Mode
steps.content: Restart in Safe Mode to disable third-party apps.

steps.title: Review Recent Apps
steps.content: Check apps installed around when problems started.

steps.title: Uninstall Suspicious Apps
steps.content: Remove unfamiliar or recently installed apps.

steps.title: Clear Browser Data
steps.content: Clear cache, cookies, and history from all browsers.

steps.title: Run Security Scan
steps.content: Use Malwarebytes Mobile or similar scanner.

steps.title: Factory Reset if Needed
steps.content: If problems persist, backup data and factory reset.

steps.title: Change Passwords
steps.content: Change passwords for accounts accessed on the device.

title: SIM Swap Protection
description: Preventing SIM swap attacks on your phone number

steps.title: Set Carrier PIN
steps.content: Add a PIN or password to your carrier account.

steps.title: Enable Port Freeze
steps.content: Ask carrier to freeze number porting.

steps.title: Use Non-SMS 2FA
steps.content: Switch from SMS to authenticator apps where possible.

steps.title: Monitor for Signs
steps.content: Watch for unexpected "No Service" on your phone.

steps.title: Limit Phone Exposure
steps.content: Don't publish phone number publicly.

steps.title: Consider Google Voice
steps.content: Use Google Voice number for 2FA instead of real number.

steps.title: Act Fast if Swapped
steps.content: If SIM swapped, contact carrier immediately.

title: Email Security Basics
description: Securing your email accounts and communications

steps.title: Use Strong Password
steps.content: Email password should be unique and 16+ characters.

steps.title: Enable 2FA
steps.content: Add two-factor authentication to all email accounts.

steps.title: Review Connected Apps
steps.content: Check and revoke unnecessary third-party access.

steps.title: Check Forwarding Rules
steps.content: Ensure no unauthorized forwarding is configured.

steps.title: Review Recovery Options
steps.content: Verify recovery email and phone are yours.

steps.title: Enable Security Alerts
steps.content: Turn on notifications for suspicious activity.

steps.title: Be Wary of Links
steps.content: Hover over links before clicking. Verify senders.

steps.title: Use Encrypted Email
steps.content: Consider ProtonMail or enable encryption for sensitive emails.

title: Phishing Email Detection
description: How to identify and handle phishing emails

steps.title: Check Sender Address
steps.content: Look at actual email address, not display name.

steps.title: Look for Urgency
steps.content: Phishing creates false urgency to bypass thinking.

steps.title: Hover Over Links
steps.content: Check URL before clicking - does it match the claimed sender?

steps.title: Check for Errors
steps.content: Look for spelling, grammar, or formatting issues.

steps.title: Verify Through Other Channel
steps.content: Contact company directly through known channels.

steps.title: Don't Download Attachments
steps.content: Unexpected attachments are high risk.

steps.title: Report Phishing
steps.content: Forward to IT and/or phishing@company.com.

steps.title: Delete the Email
steps.content: Remove from inbox and trash completely.

title: Email Encryption Setup
description: Setting up encrypted email communications

steps.title: Choose a Method
steps.content: Options: ProtonMail, S/MIME, PGP, or provider encryption.

steps.title: ProtonMail (Easiest)
steps.content: Create ProtonMail account for encrypted communications.

steps.title: Enable Provider Encryption
steps.content: Gmail, Outlook have built-in encryption options.

steps.title: Install PGP (Advanced)
steps.content: Install GPG/PGP tools for maximum control.

steps.title: Generate Keys
steps.content: Create public/private key pair for PGP.

steps.title: Exchange Public Keys
steps.content: Share public key with contacts who need to send encrypted mail.

steps.title: Test Encryption
steps.content: Send test encrypted emails to verify setup.

title: Business Email Compromise Response
description: Handling BEC attacks and wire fraud attempts

steps.title: Stop the Transaction
steps.content: If money was sent, contact bank immediately to attempt recall.
steps.warning: Act within minutes for best chance of recovery.

steps.title: Preserve Evidence
steps.content: Don't delete emails. Screenshot everything.

steps.title: Report to FBI
steps.content: File report at ic3.gov immediately.

steps.title: Notify Affected Parties
steps.content: Alert anyone whose info was in the emails.

steps.title: Secure the Account
steps.content: If email was compromised, secure with new password and 2FA.

steps.title: Check for Forwarding Rules
steps.content: Remove any rules set by attackers.

steps.title: Review Other Transactions
steps.content: Check for other fraudulent requests.

steps.title: Implement Verification Procedures
steps.content: Add phone verification for financial requests.

title: Social Media Account Security
description: Securing your social media presence

steps.title: Use Unique Passwords
steps.content: Different strong password for each platform.

steps.title: Enable 2FA
steps.content: Add two-factor to all social accounts.

steps.title: Review Privacy Settings
steps.content: Set posts and profile to appropriate visibility.

steps.title: Limit Personal Info
steps.content: Don't share birthdate, address, or phone publicly.

steps.title: Review Connected Apps
steps.content: Remove apps you no longer use.

steps.title: Check Active Sessions
steps.content: Review and terminate unknown sessions.

steps.title: Be Careful What You Share
steps.content: Attackers use personal details for social engineering.

steps.title: Watch for Impersonation
steps.content: Monitor for fake accounts using your identity.

title: Social Media Account Recovery
description: Recovering hacked social media accounts

steps.title: Try Password Reset
steps.content: Use official password reset process.

steps.title: Use Platform Recovery
steps.content: Facebook, Instagram, Twitter have hacked account recovery forms.

steps.title: Verify Identity
steps.content: Prepare ID for identity verification if required.

steps.title: Secure Email First
steps.content: Ensure your email account is secure before recovery.

steps.title: Report to Platform
steps.content: Report the account as compromised.

steps.title: Once Recovered
steps.content: Change password, enable 2FA, review all settings.

steps.title: Check Connected Accounts
steps.content: Secure accounts that used social login.

steps.title: Alert Followers
steps.content: Notify followers about the compromise.

title: Doxxing Response
description: What to do if your personal information is published online

steps.title: Document Everything
steps.content: Screenshot the doxxing before it's removed.

steps.title: Report to Platforms
steps.content: Report the content on each platform for removal.

steps.title: Google Yourself
steps.content: Search for other instances of your info.

steps.title: Request Removal
steps.content: Contact sites directly to remove information.

steps.title: Secure Your Accounts
steps.content: Change passwords, enable 2FA on everything.

steps.title: Alert Family
steps.content: Warn family members who might also be targeted.

steps.title: Consider Police Report
steps.content: If threats accompany doxxing, file police report.

steps.title: Use Removal Services
steps.content: Consider services like DeleteMe for data removal.

steps.title: Lock Down Socials
steps.content: Set all social media to private temporarily.

title: Online Harassment Response
description: Dealing with cyberbullying and online harassment

steps.title: Don't Engage
steps.content: Engaging often escalates. Avoid responding.

steps.title: Document Everything
steps.content: Screenshot all harassment with timestamps.

steps.title: Block the Harasser
steps.content: Use platform blocking features.

steps.title: Report to Platform
steps.content: Report harassment using official channels.

steps.title: Adjust Privacy Settings
steps.content: Limit who can contact or mention you.

steps.title: Secure Accounts
steps.content: Ensure all accounts have strong security.

steps.title: Report to Police if Needed
steps.content: Threats of violence should be reported to authorities.

steps.title: Seek Support
steps.content: Reach out to friends, family, or support organizations.

title: Cloud Storage Security
description: Securing files in cloud storage services

steps.title: Use Strong Authentication
steps.content: Enable 2FA on all cloud storage accounts.

steps.title: Review Shared Files
steps.content: Audit and remove unnecessary shares.

steps.title: Encrypt Sensitive Files
steps.content: Use Cryptomator or BoxCryptor for sensitive files.

steps.title: Check Sharing Settings
steps.content: Ensure links aren't publicly accessible.

steps.title: Review Connected Apps
steps.content: Remove third-party apps with access to files.

steps.title: Enable Activity Alerts
steps.content: Get notifications for sharing changes.

steps.title: Regular Backup
steps.content: Don't rely only on cloud - have local backups.

steps.title: Know Your Provider
steps.content: Understand provider's encryption and access policies.

title: AWS Security Basics
description: Essential security configurations for AWS accounts

steps.title: Secure Root Account
steps.content: Enable MFA on root, never use for daily tasks.

steps.title: Create IAM Users
steps.content: Create individual IAM users for everyone.

steps.title: Implement Least Privilege
steps.content: Give minimum permissions needed.

steps.title: Enable CloudTrail
steps.content: Enable CloudTrail for all regions for auditing.

steps.title: Configure GuardDuty
steps.content: Enable GuardDuty for threat detection.

steps.title: Secure S3 Buckets
steps.content: Block public access by default.
steps.warning: S3 misconfigurations are common breach causes.

steps.title: Enable Config Rules
steps.content: Use AWS Config for compliance monitoring.

steps.title: Review Security Hub
steps.content: Use Security Hub for centralized security view.

steps.title: Rotate Access Keys
steps.content: Regularly rotate IAM access keys.

steps.title: Set Billing Alerts
steps.content: Create billing alerts for unusual usage.

title: Cloud Access Review
description: Auditing access to cloud services

steps.title: Inventory Cloud Services
steps.content: List all cloud services in use.

steps.title: Identify Admins
steps.content: Document who has administrative access.

steps.title: Review User Access
steps.content: Check each user's permissions are appropriate.

steps.title: Remove Stale Accounts
steps.content: Disable accounts for departed employees.

steps.title: Check API Keys
steps.content: Audit API keys and service accounts.

steps.title: Review External Sharing
steps.content: Check what's shared with external users.

steps.title: Document Findings
steps.content: Record issues and remediation actions.

steps.title: Schedule Regular Reviews
steps.content: Conduct quarterly access reviews.

title: SaaS Application Security
description: Securing Software-as-a-Service applications

steps.title: Inventory SaaS Apps
steps.content: Create list of all SaaS applications in use.

steps.title: Implement SSO
steps.content: Use single sign-on where possible for central control.

steps.title: Enforce MFA
steps.content: Require multi-factor authentication for all SaaS apps.

steps.title: Review Permissions
steps.content: Audit user permissions in each application.

steps.title: Monitor for Shadow IT
steps.content: Identify unauthorized SaaS usage.

steps.title: Configure Security Settings
steps.content: Enable available security features in each app.

steps.title: Review API Access
steps.content: Check third-party integrations and API access.

steps.title: Data Export Policies
steps.content: Understand data portability and export options.

title: Browser Security Hardening
description: Securing your web browser against threats

steps.title: Keep Updated
steps.content: Enable auto-updates for your browser.

steps.title: Review Extensions
steps.content: Remove unnecessary extensions. They can be security risks.

steps.title: Install Security Extensions
steps.content: Add uBlock Origin and HTTPS Everywhere.

steps.title: Enable Safe Browsing
steps.content: Turn on phishing and malware protection.

steps.title: Manage Cookies
steps.content: Configure to clear cookies on exit or use strict mode.

steps.title: Disable Third-Party Cookies
steps.content: Block cross-site tracking cookies.

steps.title: Review Site Permissions
steps.content: Audit camera, mic, location, notification permissions.

steps.title: Use Private Browsing
steps.content: Use incognito mode for sensitive activities.

steps.title: Consider Privacy Browser
steps.content: Brave or Firefox with privacy settings for daily use.

title: Browser Extension Audit
description: Reviewing and securing browser extensions

steps.title: List All Extensions
steps.content: Go to extension settings and review installed extensions.

steps.title: Remove Unused
steps.content: Delete extensions you don't actively use.

steps.title: Check Permissions
steps.content: Review what data each extension can access.
steps.warning: Some extensions can read all website data.

steps.title: Verify Sources
steps.content: Research unfamiliar extensions before keeping.

steps.title: Check for Updates
steps.content: Ensure extensions are up to date.

steps.title: Review Recently Installed
steps.content: Did problems start after installing an extension?

steps.title: Use Minimal Extensions
steps.content: Only install what you truly need.

title: Personal Privacy Audit
description: Comprehensive review of your digital privacy

steps.title: Google Yourself
steps.content: Search your name and see what's publicly available.

steps.title: Check Data Brokers
steps.content: Opt out from Spokeo, WhitePages, BeenVerified, etc.

steps.title: Review Social Privacy
steps.content: Audit privacy settings on all social platforms.

steps.title: Check Location History
steps.content: Review and delete Google, Apple location history.

steps.title: Audit App Permissions
steps.content: Review what apps access on your devices.

steps.title: Review Connected Accounts
steps.content: Check OAuth/connected apps on major accounts.

steps.title: Check Ad Preferences
steps.content: Review and limit ad tracking settings.

steps.title: Consider Privacy Tools
steps.content: Use VPN, privacy-focused browser, encrypted messaging.

title: Data Broker Opt-Out
description: Removing your information from data broker sites

steps.title: Identify Data Brokers
steps.content: Major ones: Spokeo, WhitePages, BeenVerified, Intelius.

steps.title: Search Each Site
steps.content: Find your listings on each data broker.

steps.title: Submit Opt-Out Requests
steps.content: Use each site's opt-out process.

steps.title: Document Requests
steps.content: Track which sites you've requested removal from.

steps.title: Follow Up
steps.content: Verify removal after 30-60 days.

steps.title: Repeat Periodically
steps.content: Data brokers may re-add you; check annually.

steps.title: Consider Removal Service
steps.content: DeleteMe or Kanary automate this process.

title: Anonymous Browsing Setup
description: Setting up anonymous internet browsing

steps.title: Install Tor Browser
steps.content: Download Tor from torproject.org for anonymous browsing.

steps.title: Use VPN
steps.content: Route traffic through VPN for additional privacy.

steps.title: Privacy-Focused Browser
steps.content: Use Brave or hardened Firefox for daily browsing.

steps.title: Block Trackers
steps.content: Install uBlock Origin and Privacy Badger.

steps.title: Use Private Search
steps.content: DuckDuckGo or Startpage instead of Google.

steps.title: Manage Cookies
steps.content: Auto-clear cookies or use containers.

steps.content: WebRTC can leak your IP even with VPN.

steps.title: Use Compartmentalization
steps.content: Different browsers for different activities.

title: Laptop Security Setup
description: Securing your laptop computer

steps.content: Use BitLocker (Windows) or FileVault (Mac).

steps.title: Set Strong Password
steps.content: Use complex password for login.

steps.title: Enable Auto-Lock
steps.content: Lock after 5 minutes of inactivity.

steps.title: Enable Find My Device
steps.content: Configure tracking for lost device recovery.

steps.title: Install Updates
steps.content: Enable automatic OS and software updates.

steps.title: Use Antivirus
steps.content: Enable Windows Defender or install reputable AV.

steps.title: Enable Firewall
steps.content: Ensure OS firewall is enabled.

steps.title: Physical Security
steps.content: Use cable lock in public places.

steps.title: Backup Regularly
steps.content: Maintain regular backups of important data.

title: Desktop Computer Security
description: Securing your desktop workstation

steps.title: Enable Encryption
steps.content: BitLocker, FileVault, or LUKS for full disk encryption.

steps.title: Strong Login Credentials
steps.content: Use password or PIN for login.

steps.title: Separate Admin Account
steps.content: Use standard account for daily use, admin for changes.

steps.title: Enable Firewall
steps.content: Configure and enable OS firewall.

steps.title: Update Regularly
steps.content: Enable automatic updates for OS and software.

steps.title: Use Antimalware
steps.content: Install and maintain updated antimalware.

steps.title: Physical Security
steps.content: Lock room or use Kensington lock.

steps.title: BIOS Password
steps.content: Set BIOS password for additional security.

title: USB Drive Security

steps.title: Use Data Blockers

steps.title: Secure Important USBs
steps.content: Track and secure USB drives with sensitive data.

steps.title: Wipe Before Disposal
steps.content: Securely wipe USB drives before discarding.

title: IoT Device Security
description: Securing smart home and IoT devices

steps.title: Change Default Passwords
steps.content: Never leave factory default passwords.

steps.title: Update Firmware
steps.content: Keep device firmware updated.

steps.title: Separate Network
steps.content: Put IoT devices on guest network.
steps.tip: Isolates them from your main devices.

steps.title: Disable Unused Features
steps.content: Turn off remote access if not needed.

steps.title: Review Privacy Settings
steps.content: Limit data collection where possible.

steps.title: Research Before Buying

steps.title: Monitor Network
steps.content: Watch for unusual traffic from IoT devices.

title: 3-2-1 Backup Strategy

steps.content: 3 copies, 2 different media, 1 offsite.

steps.title: Primary Copy
steps.content: Your working data on your computer.

steps.title: Local Backup
steps.content: External drive or NAS for first backup.

steps.title: Offsite Backup
steps.content: Cloud backup or drive at different location.

steps.title: Automate Backups
steps.content: Schedule automatic backups.

steps.title: Encrypt Backups
steps.content: Encrypt backup data, especially cloud backups.

steps.title: Test Restores
steps.content: Regularly verify you can restore from backups.

steps.title: Document Procedures
steps.content: Write down backup and restore procedures.

description: Configuring Time Machine backups on macOS

steps.title: Get External Drive
steps.content: Use drive 2x your Mac's storage or larger.

steps.title: Format Drive
steps.content: Format as APFS or Mac OS Extended (Journaled).

steps.title: Enable Time Machine
steps.content: System Preferences > Time Machine > Select Disk.

steps.title: Enable Encryption
steps.content: Check "Encrypt backups" for security.

steps.title: Exclude Unnecessary
steps.content: Exclude large files you don't need backed up.

steps.title: Let It Complete
steps.content: First backup takes time - let it finish.

steps.title: Test Restore
steps.content: Practice restoring a file to verify it works.

title: Windows Backup Setup
description: Configuring backups on Windows

steps.title: Use File History
steps.content: Settings > Update & Security > Backup.

steps.title: Add External Drive
steps.content: Connect and select backup drive.

steps.title: Configure File History
steps.content: Select folders to back up.

steps.title: Set Backup Frequency
steps.content: Choose how often to save copies.

steps.title: Consider System Image
steps.content: Create system image for full recovery.

steps.title: Add Cloud Backup
steps.content: Use OneDrive or third-party for offsite.

steps.title: Test Restore
steps.content: Verify you can restore files.

title: Cloud Backup Setup
description: Setting up secure cloud backup

steps.title: Choose Provider
steps.content: Backblaze, iDrive, Carbonite, or cloud storage.

steps.title: Enable Encryption
steps.content: Use client-side encryption before upload.

steps.title: Select Backup Scope
steps.content: Choose what files to back up.

steps.title: Configure Schedule
steps.content: Set continuous or scheduled backups.

steps.title: Secure the Account

steps.title: Monitor Backups
steps.content: Check that backups complete successfully.

steps.title: Test Restore
steps.content: Periodically download and verify files.

title: Secure Coding Practices
description: Writing secure code from the start

steps.title: Validate All Input
steps.content: Never trust user input. Validate and sanitize.

steps.title: Parameterize Queries
steps.content: Use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection.

steps.title: Encode Output
steps.content: Encode data when outputting to prevent XSS.

steps.title: Use HTTPS
steps.content: Always use HTTPS for data in transit.

steps.title: Hash Passwords
steps.content: Use bcrypt, Argon2, or PBKDF2 for passwords.

steps.title: Implement Auth Properly
steps.content: Use proven auth libraries, not custom solutions.

steps.title: Handle Errors Safely
steps.content: Don't expose sensitive info in error messages.

steps.title: Keep Dependencies Updated
steps.content: Regularly update libraries and dependencies.

steps.title: Use Security Headers
steps.content: Implement CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.

title: Git Security Best Practices
description: Securing your Git repositories and workflow

steps.title: Never Commit Secrets
steps.content: Use .gitignore for config files with secrets.

steps.title: Use Git Hooks
steps.content: Pre-commit hooks to detect secrets before push.

steps.title: Sign Commits
steps.content: Use GPG signing to verify commit authenticity.

steps.title: Protect Branches
steps.content: Require reviews for main/master branch.

steps.title: Use SSH Keys
steps.content: Prefer SSH over HTTPS for authentication.

steps.title: Enable 2FA
steps.content: Enable 2FA on GitHub/GitLab accounts.

steps.title: Review Access
steps.content: Regularly audit who has repo access.

steps.title: Scan for Secrets
steps.content: Use tools like git-secrets or truffleHog.

steps.title: Use Authentication
steps.content: Require auth for all API endpoints.

steps.title: Use HTTPS Only
steps.content: Never allow API calls over HTTP.

steps.title: Implement Rate Limiting
steps.content: Prevent abuse with rate limits.

steps.title: Validate Input
steps.content: Validate all request parameters.

steps.title: Use Proper Auth
steps.content: OAuth 2.0 or API keys with rotation.

steps.title: Don't Expose Internals
steps.content: Generic error messages, no stack traces.

steps.title: Log API Access
steps.content: Maintain logs of API usage.

steps.title: Version Your API
steps.content: Allow deprecation without breaking clients.

title: Dependency Security

steps.title: Audit Dependencies
steps.content: Run npm audit, pip check, or equivalent.

steps.title: Update Regularly
steps.content: Keep dependencies updated.

steps.title: Review Before Adding
steps.content: Check package reputation before installing.

steps.title: Pin Versions
steps.content: Use lock files and pin specific versions.

steps.title: Monitor for CVEs
steps.content: Use Dependabot or Snyk for alerts.

steps.title: Remove Unused
steps.content: Delete dependencies you no longer need.

steps.title: Private Registry
steps.content: Consider private npm/PyPI for control.

title: Secrets Management

steps.title: Never Hardcode
steps.content: Never put secrets directly in code.

steps.title: Use Environment Variables
steps.content: Load secrets from environment variables.

steps.title: Use Secrets Manager
steps.content: AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, etc.

steps.title: Rotate Regularly
steps.content: Rotate API keys and credentials periodically.

steps.title: Limit Scope
steps.content: Use least-privilege for API keys.

steps.title: Audit Access
steps.content: Log and monitor secret access.

steps.title: Encrypt at Rest
steps.content: Encrypt secrets in configuration files.

steps.title: Scan Images

steps.title: Limit Resources

steps.title: Sign Images

steps.title: Update Base Images
steps.content: Regularly rebuild with updated base images.

steps.title: Minimal Data
steps.content: Only take data you need. Consider travel-only device.

steps.title: Enable Encryption
steps.content: Ensure full disk encryption is enabled.

steps.title: Strong Lock Screen
steps.content: Use strong PIN/password, not face unlock at borders.

steps.title: Use VPN
steps.content: Connect through VPN on all networks.

steps.title: Physical Security
steps.content: Don't leave devices unattended.

steps.title: Hotel Safe Limitations
steps.content: Hotel safes aren't very secure. Keep devices with you.

steps.title: Border Crossings
steps.content: Know your rights. Consider powered-off devices.

steps.title: Public WiFi Caution
steps.content: Assume all public networks are hostile.

steps.title: Shred Sensitive Items
steps.content: Shred papers with personal/business info.

steps.title: Clean Whiteboards

steps.title: Visitor Awareness

steps.title: Sign Out of Accounts

steps.title: Factory Reset

steps.title: Recycle Properly
steps.content: Use certified e-waste recyclers.

steps.title: Phishing Simulations

steps.title: Clear Policies
steps.content: Document and communicate security policies.

steps.title: Report Mechanisms
steps.content: Make it easy to report suspicious activity.

steps.title: No Blame Culture
steps.content: Encourage reporting without fear of punishment.

steps.title: Real Examples
steps.content: Share real breach stories to illustrate risks.

steps.title: Role-Specific Training
steps.content: Tailor training to job roles.

steps.title: Measure Effectiveness
steps.content: Track metrics and improve training.

steps.title: Document Procedures

steps.title: Review and Update

steps.title: Regular Reviews

steps.title: Incident Notification

steps.title: Data Handling
steps.content: Understand how vendor handles your data.

steps.content: Teach how to report inappropriate content.

steps.title: Lead by Example
steps.content: Model good digital citizenship.
